activity.notes: Nefertiti was the principal queen (Great Royal Wife) of Akhenaten and an unusually prominent royal figure in the Amarna court. ATLAS does not promote the disputed identification with a later female co-ruler or pharaoh to settled fact; this Activity records only her securely attested royal role during Akhenaten's reign.

sources.title: Relief of Queen Nefertiti — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum identifies Nefertiti as Akhenaten's principal queen and a powerful court figure during the Amarna Period, approximately 1353–1336 BCE.
